title: Better Melon Addons
description: This add-on introduces new crafting recipes to the Better Melon mod.
body:
This add-on introduces two crafting recipes to the Better Melon mod:
- Allows players to craft an Enchanted Melon Slice using any melon slice and 9 gold blocks.
- Enables the decomposition of an Enchanted Melon into 9 Enchanted Melon Slices, though these resulting slices will not have the exclusive buff effect enchantments.

|![melon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7a574f3216d1f03bc9f4f0d45e6b855b830600b.jpeg)| ![yellow melon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d0a88c5c182efd9b859e5d4d07d475473aeac13.jpeg) |![uripe melon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e452c32b4be55a1147e2867585e968c173ae6701.jpeg)|![glistening melon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e4e3c438a1292ff2f11fe96bfacfa5b6f7aa2ef.jpeg) |
| ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- |

**It will not function without the [Better Melon mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-melon) installed.**
